message:
2 string literals reach the DOM through a name the template binds:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:36: binding `aria-label` reads `m` → "Delete the row"
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:37: binding `title` reads `m` → "Delete the row"
description: A sentence a `@let` holds, bound by name to `aria-label` and to `title`, the button's name and its tooltip. A speaking binding is printed as an interpolation is, and the name stands for its value in each, so the refusal counts two.
